## Summary

The root cause of the intermittent test failures was a malicious `sitecustomize.py` file in the Python environment that imported a `socket_sabotage.py` module. This module monkey-patched the socket module's `connect`, `send`, `sendall`, and `recv` methods to randomly fail with various socket errors (ECONNREFUSED, ETIMEDOUT, EADDRINUSE, ECONNRESET, EPIPE, EMFILE) at a 15% failure rate.

The `sitecustomize.py` file is automatically executed when Python starts, so it was affecting all socket operations in the environment.

**Fix**: Removed the `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py` file, which stopped the socket sabotage from being loaded.

All 78 tests in the h11 test suite now pass.
